"""Actual immutable fixture bootstrap; it never prepares or runs a task."""

import json
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import fixture_dependency

from coleman.tasks.identity import ExecutorRecipe

SENTINELS = Path(SENTINEL_DIRECTORY)
SENTINELS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(SENTINELS / "provider-imported").write_text("actual provider module executed")
RECIPE = ExecutorRecipe.from_json(Path(__file__).with_suffix(".declarations.json").read_bytes())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TupleCodec:
    declaration: object

    def validate(self, value: object) -> tuple[float, ...]:
        if type(value) is not tuple or not all(type(item) is float and math.isfinite(item) for item in value):
            raise ValueError("fixture codec requires a complete tuple of finite binary64 values")
        return value

    def decode(self, body: str) -> tuple[float, ...]:
        return self.validate(tuple(json.loads(body)))

    def encode(self, value: tuple[float, ...]) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.validate(value), separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FixtureExecutor:
    definition: object
    configuration_codec: TupleCodec
    input_codec: TupleCodec
    coordinate_codec: TupleCodec
    coordinate_result_codec: TupleCodec
    final_result_codec: TupleCodec
    progress_proof_codec: None = None

    def prepare(self, configuration, inputs, context):
        (SENTINELS / "prepare-called").write_text("must not run while loading")
        raise AssertionError("capture/loading must never prepare mathematical or source work")


def factory() -> FixtureExecutor:
    (SENTINELS / "factory-called").write_text(str(fixture_dependency.VALUE))
    return FixtureExecutor(
        RECIPE.binding,
        TupleCodec(RECIPE.codec_for("configuration")),
        TupleCodec(RECIPE.codec_for("inputs")),
        TupleCodec(RECIPE.codec_for("coordinate")),
        TupleCodec(RECIPE.codec_for("coordinate_result")),
        TupleCodec(RECIPE.codec_for("final_result")),
    )
